findings.desc: packages/main/src/core/closeout-trust.ts:606-675 — The promised separation between review retention and artifact authority is not mechanically enforced. classifyCurrentCloseoutArtifactForReviewRetention accepts a same-UID-forgeable causal receipt and keeps the signed review current, while validateCurrentCloseoutArtifact always returns invalid because latestValidCloseoutReceipt is deliberately null. rg shows validateCurrentCloseoutArtifact has no production gate consumer (only closeout-trust-smoke); production artifact readers consume test/summary/delivery/live-smoke evidence through their separate readers without canonical writer provenance. Therefore a local actor can replace an artifact and co-commit a forged causal receipt, preserve the review, and reach the ordinary artifact consumer without the re-review that previously supplied the only writer-authority boundary. Either add an actual independently authoritative admissibility check to every registered artifact consumer (isolated signature/capability or equivalent), or keep such post-review writes review-invalidating; comments/tests that an unused helper remains fail-closed are insufficient.
findings.dismissReason: False positive disproven by active retired-Authority truth sources, F-010 strong counter-evidence, removal of pseudo-authority helpers, and independent specialized gate consumer tests.

findings.desc: packages/main/src/handlers/done-prepare.ts:1442-1468 — The new convergence counters do not measure the closeout history they claim to prove. metadataRollbacks and humanConfirmations only regex the current invocation step text; reviewerReattestations counts current blocking runbook rows (which is necessarily zero on PASS), not new reviewer runs/passes; successfulCloseout is only the final snapshot. A story that already rolled back, received a human story_resume, or re-attested reviewers before this invocation still renders all zero. The smoke test constructs the same final snapshot, so it cannot catch this. Capture a closeout baseline and derive counts from persisted signed process events/review-run/pass identities and validation receipts over that interval, including initial/final phase/round/receipt identity, then assert those measured counts before PASS.
findings.resolvedReason: Fixed by d952808c92 durable phase/human/validation/reviewer fact collection; current focused flow and convergence tests pass.

findings.desc: packages/main/src/handlers/validate-concept.ts:120-155 — scanDeletedSymbols is still a line regex keyed only by declaration kind+name, not the declaration/file/scope/signature identity required by CHK-003. It ignores class methods/constructors and collapses overloads/same-name declarations. Repro against current dist: a diff replacing `export function f(x: string): string;` with `export function f(x: number): number;` returns [], and a changed method signature also returns []; thus removal of one overload/signature can be hidden by any added same-name declaration. The focused smoke passes because it tests only an unmatched removed overload and explicitly narrows methods/constructors out of scope, contradicting the must verification intents. Implement declaration-aware identity (or an explicit fail-closed parser/ambiguity diagnostic) and cover same-name overload/scope/signature replacement, methods, and constructors.
findings.resolvedReason: Fixed by f9948df787 syntax-aware declaration identity including file/scope/kind/signature/multiplicity; concept corpus passes.

findings.desc: CHK-003 must coverage is materially incomplete and the recorded evidence overclaims it. scanDeletedSymbols is still regex-based and collapses declarations to kind:name, so deleting one overload while another same-name overload remains is hidden; it also ignores non-exported TypeScript functions, class methods, and constructors even though CHK-003:edge:2 explicitly requires those supported forms and deterministic same-name/scope handling. The smoke test instead asserts those forms are outside the deletion surface, and its overload case removes the only same-name declaration, so it cannot prove CHK-003:adversarial:2. Replace name-only pairing with declaration identity/multiplicity (scope/kind/signature or an explicit bounded supported surface), then add a retained-same-name overload negative and the required non-exported/method/constructor cases before claiming all must intents covered.
findings.resolvedReason: Coverage gap fixed by f9948df787 and expanded concept regression corpus for overloads, methods, constructors, and cross-file identities.

findings.desc: CHK-002 one-pass acceptance counters are not measured from lifecycle history, so DONE prepare can report zero-cost convergence without proving it. deriveDonePreparePassConvergence infers metadataRollbacks/humanConfirmations by regexing only current step text and reviewerReattestations from current blocking runbook rows; it does not bind initial/final phase, review round/receipt identity, actual artifact writer sequence, or prior re-attestation/ack/backstep events. closeoutWriteSequence is a constant string. The positive smoke mostly asserts the resulting literal zeros, so a past metadata-only rollback or reviewer re-attestation is invisible. Emit counters from durable process events/review receipt identity and artifact receipts over the closeout window, and add a negative fixture containing a prior backstep/re-attestation/human ack that must make PASS convergence fail.
findings.resolvedReason: Durable convergence history implemented by d952808c92 and completed for the pre-TEST edge by 1c694f1c8e; real collector regression passes.

findings.desc: packages/main/src/handlers/validate-concept.ts:120-155 — HIGH: scanDeletedSymbols keys removed/added declarations only by kind+name across the entire multi-file diff. A retained declaration edit in one file therefore cancels a true deletion of the same-named export in another file, causing the concept preflight to miss the deletion and potentially skip lattice-review-concept. Repro after build: feed a diff that deletes export function shared from src/a.ts while changing export function shared in src/b.ts; scanDeletedSymbols returns [] instead of [shared]. Track current diff file (and Python declaration scope where applicable) in the declaration identity, while keeping same-file signature/body edits paired; add the cross-file duplicate-name regression.
findings.resolvedReason: Fixed by f9948df787 file/scope/signature/multiplicity identity; cross-file same-name deletion regression passes.

findings.desc: packages/main/src/handlers/done-prepare.ts:1442-1467 — MEDIUM: the advertised convergence counters are inferred from absence/presence of phrases in the final DonePrepareStep text, not from durable lifecycle events. metadataRollbacks and humanConfirmations default to zero whenever those words are absent; reviewerReattestations counts only current blocking rows (a completed re-attestation is zero); unchangedSuiteExecutions is forced to zero whenever the output is not recognized as reused. Thus a run can print successfulCloseout=1 and all-zero counters after earlier metadata rollback/re-attestation/human intervention, so the acceptance metric is cosmetic rather than the requested mechanical proof. Derive counts from bounded process-event/receipt deltas for this closeout attempt (or rename them to current-run diagnostics and add a real one-pass integration assertion over event history).
findings.resolvedReason: Fixed by d952808c92 durable typed event facts; missing windows omit zero claims and focused flow tests pass.

findings.desc: F-005 is only partially fixed: collectDonePrepareConvergenceFacts counts reviewer runs/passes strictly after the successful TEST entry (`startedAt > testEntry.timestamp` / `createdAt > testEntry.timestamp`). The costly failure this story targets can re-run review while the story is still in REVIEW—e.g. transition-time validation writes metadata, REVIEW→TEST remains blocked, and reviewers re-attest before the eventual successful TEST transition. Those extra identities occur between the REVIEW anchor and TEST entry, so current telemetry reports reviewerReattestations=0 and DONE prepare may claim zero-cost convergence. The existing negative test injects reviewerIdentityIds directly and never exercises this collector window. Bind the initial complete-review receipt identities at the REVIEW anchor (or otherwise establish a baseline), count additional valid run/pass identities from that baseline through closeout including the pre-TEST interval, and add a real-store fixture with an extra pre-TEST reviewer run/pass that makes the PASS convergence invariant fail.
findings.resolvedReason: Fixed by 1c694f1c8e: collector anchors at REVIEW, uses first completed identity per lane as baseline, counts later same-binding identities before TEST, and excludes old rounds.

findings.desc: CHK-001 acceptance/evidence is internally inconsistent after the approved local-assurance scope decision. CHK-001:happy:0 still requires each writer to record a signed canonical writer identity, while the implementation and process-fact contract deliberately define closeout-write-receipts as unsigned cooperative lineage and the hostile same-UID regression proves a registered writer label can be forged yet still retain review. That hostile case is an acceptable explicit non-goal only if the must intent is updated to the approved cooperative local-runtime boundary; current evidence must not claim the signed identity requirement passed. Reconcile the verificationIntent/user-visible contract (or implement isolated signing authority) and keep the existing independent consumer-gate tests.
findings.resolvedReason: Resolved in PLAN: CHK-001 now explicitly specifies cooperative local-runtime lineage, independent artifact gates, and hostile same-UID as a non-goal; scope re-review passed.

findings.desc: Disproven audit for B-10b0:F-001: the prior finding conflated cooperative code-review freshness with artifact admissibility and imposed hostile same-UID canonical-writer authentication that the active local-assurance contract explicitly does not claim. 7050b07a24 removes the unused pseudo-authority helpers and keeps lineage consumption limited to review retention; production gates continue their specialized artifact schema/hash/freshness/reviewer validation and never consume the lineage receipt as artifact approval.

disprovenEvidence.summary: Active truth sources retire server-backed Authority semantics and require local proof-admissibility vocabulary; local-key/cooperative receipts must not be promoted to Authority. F-001 incorrectly treated absence of canonical-writer authentication as absence of artifact validation. The current code explicitly labels receipt lineage non-authenticating, deletes the unused always-false authority helper, and contract-checks that TEST/DONE consumers retain their independent validators while not importing receipt lineage.
disprovenEvidence.reproCommand: npm run test:closeout-trust && npm run test:process-fact-contract

findings.dismissReason: Disproven audit fulfilled its purpose as strong counter-evidence for dismissing F-001 and is now already covered by the corrected contract and tests.

findings.resolvedReason: Fixed by 1c694f1c8e bounded multiline Python header parsing; def/class deletion and body-only cases pass, malformed/unterminated headers emit typed fail-closed diagnostics.

findings.desc: The positive reused-validation closeout, pre-existing dirty rejection, and current-run human_confirmation rejection pass, but the newly trusted process-events.jsonl auto-stage path lacks the required strict append-only/schema negative matrix. Current tests never exercise a current-run `validation_terminal` lookalike with an extra key, wrong story/phase/disposition/result, nonzero commandExecutions, malformed hashes/timestamp, malformed JSON, missing terminal newline, or replacement/truncation of baseline bytes. The single human_confirmation case only proves type rejection and would not catch a future weakening of the exact-key/value checks or prefix invariant. Add a table-driven manifest test for these malformed same-type events plus at least one non-append baseline mutation; every row must classify unsafe_untrusted_process_events_delta with no safe path/staging. Keep the passing real second done_prepare assertion unchanged.
findings.resolvedReason: Repro: the prior focused corpus rejected only human_confirmation and did not exercise same-type malformed validation_terminal rows. Root cause: missing strict negative matrix around the newly trusted process-events path. Fixed by 779c187d79 with an exact-valid control plus 19 fail-closed cases covering binding drift, extra fields, wrong terminal semantics, malformed hashes/time/JSON, missing newline, prefix rewrite/truncation, and mixed valid+invalid rows. Verification: npm --prefix packages/main run build; node packages/main/dist/tasks/done-prepare-auto-closeout-smoke.js; node packages/main/dist/tasks/done-prepare-merge-rerun-smoke.js all PASS.

findings.desc: packages/main/src/core/done-prepare-generated-metadata.ts:110-143 [HIGH] The new process-events allowlist validates only shape/format after the baseline prefix; it does not bind attemptId/reviewRound/timestamp/commandSetHash/materialHash/storyFilesHash to the current done_prepare validation attempt or current evidence. A clean-repo probe appended a forged validation_terminal after baseline with arbitrary strings and a/b/c SHA-256 values, and buildDonePrepareGeneratedMetadataManifest classified it safe_lifecycle_metadata/currentRunGenerated=true. Thus any concurrent/injected same-shape terminal can be auto-staged and committed as trusted closeout evidence despite not being the current-run exact reused terminal. Carry the expected terminal binding in the baseline/run context and require exact equality (including current attempt/review round and canonical hashes), then add adversarial smoke cases for forged-but-well-shaped terminal, extra fields, prefix rewrite, and mixed appended lines.
findings.resolvedReason: Repro: a structurally valid forged reused validation_terminal with arbitrary attempt/review/hash values was classified safe. Root cause: generated-metadata classification had no expected current-invocation binding. Fixed by 779c187d79: done_prepare now carries the routine validation identity, current story/round/material/story-files binding, and start/end time window into both manifest preflight and commit recheck; only exact TEST/reused/pass/zero-execution append-only rows match. Verification: build, done-prepare-auto-closeout smoke, and done-prepare-merge-rerun smoke all PASS.

findings.desc: packages/main/src/core/done-prepare-generated-metadata.ts:619-649 [HIGH] F-013 exact binding now rejects the forged-valid event at manifest classification, but the commit path has a TOCTOU gap: it rebuilds the manifest before git add, then validates only staged path names and commits with a pathspec, never revalidating the staged/committed bytes. A clean temporary-repo probe intercepted the git add call, appended a mismatched-story validation_terminal after the commit-entry manifest recheck, and commitDonePrepareGeneratedMetadata returned ok:true with forgedCommitted:true. The 19 classifier negatives and official smoke pass because none mutates content between recheck and staging. Stage the validated bytes, re-read each index blob and rerun the exact append/binding predicate (or compare to captured validated digests), ensure the index contains only safe paths, then commit the verified index without a pathspec so later worktree mutations cannot replace verified bytes; add mutation seams both immediately before add and after add/before commit.
findings.resolvedReason: Repro: a deterministic mutation after commit-entry manifest verification but before git add caused forged worktree bytes to be staged and pathspec-committed. Root cause: commitDonePrepareGeneratedMetadata rechecked only path names after staging and git commit with pathspec could restage worktree bytes; it never bound the commit to verified content digests. Fixed by 7c8923f674: after git add, the function requires the staged index path set to exactly equal the safe manifest, hashes every staged blob against the manifest-verified digest, confirms worktree bytes still match, then commits the already-validated index without pathspec. Hermetic beforeAdd and afterAddBeforeCommit mutation seams both fail without advancing HEAD; transaction rollback restores verified worktree bytes and the original index. Verification: npm --prefix packages/main run build; node packages/main/dist/tasks/done-prepare-auto-closeout-smoke.js; node packages/main/dist/tasks/done-prepare-merge-rerun-smoke.js all PASS.

findings.desc: packages/main/src/core/done-prepare-generated-metadata.ts:648-690 [HIGH] F-014 remains partially open: the new exact staged-path/blob/worktree checks close the beforeAdd and afterAddBeforeCommit worktree seams, and an unrelated pre-staged path is correctly refused, but the live index can still change after the final checks and before git commit. A clean temporary-repo probe intercepted the git commit invocation, staged late-unrelated.txt after lines 648-685 had passed, then allowed the no-pathspec commit; commitDonePrepareGeneratedMetadata returned ok:true and HEAD contained both process-events.jsonl and late-unrelated.txt. Because success prevents handler rollback, the unrelated file remains committed. Freeze an immutable verified tree instead of later committing the mutable shared index: e.g. build an isolated temporary index, write-tree, verify the resulting tree/blob IDs and exact diff against the expected parent, create commit from that tree, and CAS update HEAD against the captured parent; restore/refresh the real index and worktree transaction on any failure. Add a seam immediately after final index verification/before commit, plus assertions for HEAD/index/worktree rollback.
findings.resolvedReason: Repro: late unrelated staging into the shared real index after final verification entered the prior no-pathspec git commit. Root cause: the commit input remained the mutable shared index. Fixed by f3f6f78b60: closeout now seeds an isolated temporary index from the exact old HEAD, stages only manifest paths, verifies exact temp-index path/blob digests, freezes and re-verifies an immutable tree, creates the commit with commit-tree, and CAS-updates the branch from the captured old HEAD. A final-check seam stages an unrelated real-index blob but the committed tree contains only process-events; concurrent HEAD advancement makes CAS refuse; temporary index artifacts are removed on success/failure. Verification: build, auto-closeout smoke, merge-rerun smoke PASS.

findings.desc: packages/main/src/tasks/done-prepare-auto-closeout-smoke.ts:669-742 [MEDIUM] The new deterministic beforeAdd/afterAddBeforeCommit cases prove forged-byte rejection, no HEAD advance, and rollback for a clean index, but they never seed an unrelated pre-staged path. Consequently the exact staged-path-set guard introduced at done-prepare-generated-metadata.ts:648-657 (unexpected and missing paths) and the transaction contract that rollback restores only managed paths while preserving unrelated index state are unexercised. Add a case that pre-stages an unrelated tracked file, triggers each mutation seam, asserts refusal/no HEAD movement, asserts the unrelated staged blob is byte-for-byte unchanged after rollback, and separately exercises missing/extra safe-path-set rejection.
findings.resolvedReason: Repro: prior mutation tests used a clean real index and did not prove unrelated staged-state retention or missing/extra isolated path rejection. Root cause: focused coverage omitted shared-index preservation and exact tree construction cases. Fixed by f3f6f78b60: tests seed unrelated staged blobs and prove identical blob IDs on successful isolated-tree commit and CAS-failure/rollback; late staged state remains outside the closeout commit; missing and extra temporary-index path sets both refuse without HEAD advance; worktree contents are preserved. Verification: build, auto-closeout smoke, merge-rerun smoke PASS.

findings.desc: packages/main/src/core/done-prepare-generated-metadata.ts:585-602,749-763 [HIGH] The immutable-tree/CAS path preserves tree, parent, author/committer defaults, message, unrelated staged state, and temp cleanup, but it regresses normal git commit policy semantics. It manually invokes only pre-commit and then calls git commit-tree directly. commit-tree does not run prepare-commit-msg, commit-msg, or post-commit hooks and does not honor commit.gpgSign automatically, so repositories that require message validation/transformation, audit hooks, or signed commits can have those policies silently bypassed by auto-closeout. The prior git commit implementation exercised those policies. Preserve immutable-tree/CAS while explicitly reproducing the remaining hook pipeline around a temporary message file and honoring configured signing for commit-tree (or use an equivalent plumbing flow that retains these policies); add focused tests for rejecting commit-msg and for commit.gpgSign/signing configuration, plus parent/author/committer/message assertions.
findings.resolvedReason: Repro: isolated commit-tree preserved tree/CAS safety but bypassed prepare-commit-msg, commit-msg, post-commit, and commit.gpgSign policy. Root cause: commitDonePrepareGeneratedMetadata invoked only pre-commit before raw commit-tree and supplied a fixed -m message. Fixed by 2183cf10ad: a temporary COMMIT_EDITMSG is processed in normal pre-commit → prepare-commit-msg(message source) → commit-msg order under the isolated GIT_INDEX_FILE; hook-edited content feeds commit-tree -F; commit.gpgSign/user.signingKey/gpg.format are read and required signing uses -S/fails closed; post-commit runs notification-only after successful CAS. Tests prove prepare edit reaches commit, commit-msg rejection preserves HEAD/index/worktree and cleans temps, post-commit runs on success but not CAS failure, missing SSH signing key fails closed with config/args observed, and parent/author/committer/default message remain unchanged. Build, auto-closeout smoke, merge-rerun smoke PASS.

findings.desc: packages/main/src/handlers/verifier.ts:679-708 [HIGH] The canonical-reuse failure rollback restores only worktree bytes, but autoCommitStoryMetadata stages the entire story directory at packages/main/src/core/auto-commit-metadata.ts:285-306 before a pre-commit/commit failure. Therefore the tested writer-failure path returns infra_failure with HEAD unchanged while the Git index can still contain the newly generated PASS test-evidence, validation_terminal, and closeout receipt. A later ordinary commit can publish the receipt that this path claims to have rolled back. Capture and restore the affected index entries (plus worktree bytes) transactionally around terminal/evidence/receipt persistence, and extend the rejected-persistence smoke to require an empty/byte-identical cached diff and no staged PASS/terminal/receipt after failure. Also catch writer exceptions so partial writes take the same infra-failure rollback path.

packages/main/src/handlers/verifier.ts:679-721 and packages/main/src/tasks/validation-evidence-reuse-smoke.ts:200-219 [HIGH] The new persistence-failure test proves HEAD and test-evidence working-tree bytes are restored, but it does not prove the promised canonical-writer transaction rollback. autoCommitStoryMetadata stages the entire story directory before git commit; when the injected pre-commit hook rejects, verifier restores only three worktree files and never restores the git index, leaving the attempted PASS/validation_terminal/receipt staged. The test also never snapshots/asserts process-events.jsonl or closeout-write-receipts.jsonl bytes/index state. Separately, autoCommitStoryMetadata catches closeout-receipt issuance failures and can still return the success prefix plus a warning, while verifier treats any result containing that prefix as success; no writer/receipt rejection case covers this. Make reuse persistence transactional across worktree and index for test-evidence, terminal, and receipt, treat receipt issuance failure as infra_failure, and assert exact pre/post bytes plus cached status for all three artifacts.
